Underlying AI Act obligations (Articles 53 and 55) carry their own enforcement regime. Adherence to the Code does not constitute conclusive evidence of compliance with the AI Act.","implementation_notes":"This is the Copyright Chapter of the broader GPAI Code of Practice, intended to help Signatories demonstrate compliance with Article 53(1)(c) of the EU AI Act. Adherence is voluntary and does not constitute compliance with Union copyright law per se. Measures are proportionate to provider size, with SME/startup considerations. A dynamic list of copyright-infringing websites will be maintained on an EU website to assist compliance with Measure 1.2.","confidence":0.9}
